---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a capability that the review app or pipeline does not have today
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Problem

What user-facing thing is currently hard, slow, or impossible? Who hits it,
and how often?

## Proposed solution

Describe the change you want — the more concretely, the better. Mockups,
command-line snippets, and before/after examples are encouraged.

## Alternatives considered

What other shapes did you think about, and why is the proposed one better?

## Out of scope

What this request explicitly does NOT cover. Saves reviewers from guessing.

## Dependencies

Does this touch the Rust server, the TypeScript front end, the data
schema in Neon, the R2 layout, or the deploy story? List the surfaces.
